{{Quote|Jedi Solo, I ''am'' going to arrest Jedi Knights Bazel Warv and Yaqeel Saav'etu. Will you stand aside, or do I have to move you?|Atar, to Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
'''Atar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in [[Galactic Alliance Security]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], he commanded a Security [[Squad/Legends|squad]] in an attempt to arrest the [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Bazel Warv]] and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]]. The two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], however, had just been captured by [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]], Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and Solo's parents, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]]. Atar revealed that he had a warrant for Warv and Saav'etu's arrest, but Han and Leia stalled by reentering the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]], and Fel and Jaina left the scene in Fel's [[Limousine/Legends|limousine]], using his diplomatic immunity.

Atar was later present at a secret Security [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse|blockhouse]] when a group of Jedi and media arrived to visit [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-[[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encased]] Jedi Knights [[Jysella Horn|Jysella]] and [[Valin Horn]]. Atar was alerted to the Jedi's presence by an alarm raised by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Weeze]], but when the Captain arrived with a large Security force, he was forced to allow the visitors access to the Horns, as they had acquired a legal document granting them visitation rights.

==Biography==
===Warv and Saav'etu===
{{Quote|Nothing has happened here that is any concern of yours.''"<br />"I'' decide what my concerns are, Jedi Solo. And crazy Jedi are definitely at the top of my list.|Leia Organa Solo and Atar|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Atar was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] with a bushy moustache who served in [[Galactic Alliance Security]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. By [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], he commanded his own [[Squad/Legends|squad]], having attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]].<ref name="Abyss" /> In that year, a [[Force psychosis|mysterious illness]] began to befall several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|decided]] to deal with the matter by [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encasing]] the psychotic [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref> When Jedi Knights [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]] and [[Bazel Warv]] were stricken by the psychosis, they were quickly detained outside of the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple's]] speeder entrance by Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]], and Solo's parents, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].<ref name="Abyss" />

Atar and his squad were drawn to the area by the commotion, and as Fel, Han, and Jaina took Saav'etu and Warv inside the Jedi Temple, Atar's squad surrounded Fel's [[Limousine/Legends|limousine]], on top of which was hidden the incapacitated Warv. While his men held Fel's [[Pilot/Legends|driver]], [[Baxton]], at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]], Atar confronted Organa Solo. When she denied knowledge of anything that had happened, Atar showed her that he had an image on his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] of Warv lying atop Fel's limousine. Fel and the Solos returned, however, and the Head of State ordered Atar to have his men stand down. Atar revealed that he had been unaware that the limo was Fel's and advised the Head of State not to interfere. Fel, however, replied that he would leave him to his duties only once Atar ordered his men to release his driver and vehicle. The Captain complied and then revealed that he had a warrant, signed by Head [[Judge/Legends|Judge]] of the [[Court of Jedi Affairs]] [[Arabelle Lorteli]], for the arrest of the psychotic Jedi. Han and Leia decided to buy some time by reentering the Temple and closing the gate behind them as Fel and Jaina quickly left in the Head of State's limousine.<ref name="Abyss" />

As they departed, Jaina gave Atar a mocking wave. Angered, Atar ordered that they be prevented from leaving the area, and a [[Galactic Alliance Security assault speeder]] blocked their exit. The [[Unidentified Duros lieutenant|Security officer]] in charge of the speeder refused to move for them, but [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] soon arrived, and Solo discovered that Tyrr was using a [[Lovolol cleaning droid]] to infiltrate the Temple and gather information on the Jedi. Atar then arrived on the scene and reassured the Jedi that Tyrr wouldn't do anything illegal, and when Fel requested that he allow them to pass, Atar, although reluctant to let them leave with the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], complied.<ref name="Abyss" />

===The Horns===
{{Quote|Captain Atar, I wish I could say what a pleasure it is to see you again.|Jaina Solo, to Atar|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Later, a group of Jedi [[Mind trick/Legends|tricked]] Lorteli into giving them a document granting them rights to visit [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]], two psychotic Jedi who had earlier been captured by the Galactic Alliance and encased in carbonite. The Jedi, led by Jaina Solo, arrived at a secret [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]] and demanded to be given permission to see the Horns. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Weeze]] then activated an alarm, alerting Atar and several other Security [[Officer/Legends|officers]] to the trouble.<ref name="Abyss" />

When Atar arrived on the scene, Solo showed him the document granting them visitation rights to the Horns. The Captain claimed that he didn't have the authority to allow them access to the Jedi, but [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] countered that he didn't have the authority to stop them and questioned his belief that Galactic Alliance Security was bound by [[Galactic Justice Center|Judicial Center]] writs. Atar replied that they were bound by the law, and, after Sebatyne announced that the Jedi would begin their search, he volunteered to escort the Jedi to the Horns. Forced to allow the Jedi to enter, he ordered a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Rasher Ke'e]], to allow only the Jedi access to the Horns, not the press. However, the order was in vain, as the Jedi ensured that the media accessed the Horns as well.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Sooner or later, the Remnant is going to come all the way into the Alliance. And when it does, GAS will still be here, waiting for the next time you screw up.|Atar, to Jaina Solo|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Atar was concerned for his Security career and highly prioritized capturing the psychotic Jedi, seeing them as a menace to the Galactic Alliance. He also showed Head of State Fel some courtesy, as he feared the repercussions of evoking a diplomatic incident. However, he was easily aggravated, and he threatened Jaina Solo&mdash;allowing her to leave with the cleaning droid only because they were in an Imperial diplomat's vehicle, which was thus Imperial property. Despite his often aggressive manner, Atar was also cautious, attempting to stall the Jedi and the press from accessing the Horns, knowing it could spell trouble for the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Atar was created by ''[[Star Wars]]'' author [[Troy Denning]] for ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third of nine novels in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, released on [[August 18]], [[2009]].
